rows.note: This is the all-purpose technical label for a verb that does not take a direct object.

example.english: In this sentence, “walk” is an intransitive verb and cannot be followed directly by an object.
example.traditional: 呢個例句入面嘅「行」係不及物動詞，後面唔可以直接加賓語。
example.jyutping: nei1 go3 lai6 geoi3 jap6 min6 ge3 haang4 hai6 bat1 kap6 mat6 dung6 ci4 hau6 min6 m4 ho2 ji5 zik6 zip3 gaa1 ban1 jyu5

rows.jyutping: m4 daai3 ban1 jyu5 ge3 dung6 ci4
rows.note: Use this colloquial explanatory construction when speaking plainly rather than using the technical label.

example.english: “Sleep” is an intransitive verb, so you do not need to add anything after it.
example.traditional: 「瞓」係唔帶賓語嘅動詞，唔使喺後面加任何嘢。
example.jyutping: fan3 hai6 m4 daai3 ban1 jyu5 ge3 dung6 ci4 m4 sai2 hai2 hau6 min6 gaa1 jam6 ho4 je5
